# shop-raze-cat.com

> > Professional ski and snowboard tuning tools and equipment by raze-cat, featuring the ES 2000PLUS electric edge grinder and German-manufactured accessories.

Shop-raze-cat.com is operated by Steidle Drehteile GmbH in Germany, offering professional ski service equipment including their flagship ES 2000PLUS grinding system, complete tuning sets, and accessories for DIY and professional edge sharpening, base repair, and waxing. The site features extensive educational content for beginners and advanced users.

## Key Topics

- ski-tuning
- ES 2000PLUS electric edge grinder
- edge-sharpening and edge-grinding
- ski-waxing and hot-wax
- base-repair and base-preparation
- snowboard-maintenance
- raze-cat originals (German-manufactured)
- edge-filing with angle guides
- base-brushes and rotor brushes
- professional ski-service equipment
- DIY ski maintenance
- TOKO and Vola Racing products
- ski clamps and accessories
- beginner-friendly tuning guides
